meta.title: Motif
meta.description: Open-source market of UI components, motion effects, shaders and agent skills. Generate and tune them with an agent, then take the code or skill home.

home.headline: Beautiful motion, ready to take home
home.lead: Components, motion and shaders picked from open source. Tune them live, download code that runs, or hand the skill to your agent.
home.howTitle: Pick one, tune it, take it home

pick.title: Pick an effect
pick.body: Every effect comes from an open-source project whose license allows redistribution, with a live preview and its source, license and changes on record.

tune.title: Tune it until it’s right
tune.body: Every parameter has a range tightened so any value looks good. Presets give you genuinely different looks, and a link shares your values.

take.title: Take the code or the skill
take.body: Download a runnable Vite project, install into an existing app with shadcn, or download the skill so Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can build the same effect in your project.

home.sourcesBody: Integrated code keeps its original license and copyright notices, pinned to the commits we reviewed. Thank you to their authors.
home.footer: Motif is open source (MIT). Item data generated on {date}.

market.title: Effect market
market.lead: {count} effects, all from open-source projects whose licenses allow redistribution. Preview, tune and download the code or the skill for any of them.

item.hung: The preview stopped responding and was reloaded

provenance.note: Integrated code keeps its upstream license and copyright notices. Motif’s own code is MIT licensed.

item.tunedNote: Highlighted lines hold your current values; copies and downloads include them

studio.title: Studio
studio.lead: Describe the effect you want in plain words. An agent starts from a market item, generates or rewrites the component, and you preview, tune and export it.

skills.title: Skills
skills.lead: Every effect ships with an agent skill. Copy it into your project so your own agent can build the same effect.

docs.title: Docs
docs.lead: How to use the market, tune effects, export code and skills, and contribute new effects.

export.starterLead: A Vite + React + Tailwind v4 project that shows this effect full screen with the values you tuned, plus the matching agent skill. Unzip, run npm install and npm run dev.
export.shadcnTitle: Install into an existing project with shadcn
export.shadcnLead: Run it in a project that already uses shadcn/ui. The component goes to components/motif/ and the shared motif-runtime to lib/.
export.manualLead: Copy the component file (with your values baked in) into your project, and put the shared hooks in src/lib/motif-runtime.ts.

skill.title: Hand this effect to your agent
skill.lead: A skill is a manual written for agents: when to use the effect, how to install it, the values you tuned and the rules not to break. Put it in your project and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents can build the same effect there.

skills.title: Agent skills
skills.lead: Skills are manuals written for AI agents. Add them to a project and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other agents design interfaces and motion by Motif’s principles, or reuse effects from the market directly.

how.whereBody: Claude Code reads .claude/skills/; Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI read .agents/skills/. You can also drop the downloaded folder there.
how.items: Every effect has its own skill
how.itemsBody: Each of the {count} effects in the market ships a skill with its source and parameter notes. Tune an effect on its page and download it — the skill carries your values.

motif-design.title: Design and motion (start here)
motif-design.summary: Plans a small design system first — colors, type, spacing, motion personality — reviews it against the brief, builds, then runs an accessibility and performance gate. Includes an anti-slop checklist.

motif-motion.title: Motion in React
motif-motion.summary: Springs, entrances and exits, layout animations, staggered lists and gestures with motion (formerly Framer Motion), with reduced-motion handled correctly.

motif-micro-interactions.title: Micro-interactions
motif-micro-interactions.summary: Buttons, toggles, hold-to-confirm, success and error feedback, magnetic and tilt effects: when to animate, how much and how fast.

motif-typography.title: Typography and text motion
motif-typography.summary: Pairings, scales, line length, numerals, and accessible split-text reveals and animated numbers.

motif-backgrounds.title: Backgrounds
motif-backgrounds.summary: Mesh and grain gradients, aurora, particles and grids: one per viewport, readable text, slow is premium, no banding.

motif-shaders.title: Shader effects
motif-shaders.summary: Full-screen WebGL shaders done right: DPR caps, pausing offscreen, context loss, precision, budgets and static fallbacks.

motif-scroll.title: Scroll motion
motif-scroll.summary: Scroll-triggered and scroll-linked motion: CSS scroll-driven animations, reveal-once, sticky scenes and the limits of parallax.

motif-3d.title: 3D on the web
motif-3d.summary: Globes, hero objects and spatial backgrounds: the lightest tool, render on demand, color management, disposal and poster fallbacks.
